"Hey, Papa... let's make a baby..."

One year after the death of his wife, he is suddenly tempted.
He can't resist that sweet voice, so he violates his daughter.
Even though he felt so guilty, he did the forbidden act again every night.
Before long, his daughter became pregnant.

[translated from official page]

1. You need to change locale to Japanese.

title: [Denpasoft] Koi ga Saku Koro Sakura Doki (18+) - romanization patch applied
description:
What is this?
A prepatched version of SakuSaku - https://vndb.org/v10304

What does the patch do?
Corrects the romanization to adhere to modified Hepburn
Yuma -> Yuuma
Yu-(kun/chan/poo) -> Yuu-(kun/chan/poo)
Yuri -> Yuuri (Tina's nickname for Yuuri, Yuriyuri, stays as is, since it's supposed to be that way.)
I also corrected the capitalization for all name-replacing honorifics (Nii-san, Onii-chan, Onee-chan, Senpai).
SP/Denpa's patch to fix the emote positioning and Doddler's patch to fix backlog faces and the horendous font are both applied as well.

How do I play this?
Extract the folder and click sakusaku.exe

If you already have the game from somewhere else, you can download the patch at https://mega.nz/#!u18RQDjY!ctp5Txnz8oKBqwy_krc0-I6B_LgVRA4vBFOfZnhixvc
The game and the patch have been out for a long time; I just never made a prepatched torrent. I figured it might come in handy to some lazy anon. Better late than never.

To clarify, the difference between this and SuperImo's torrent is that I just updated the patch, with the new version having the romanization in menus and images edited too.
